# Miauterm 0.1.5-coral

This release updates the Android and native package identity and improves PTY process cleanup, startup handling, and session lifecycle behavior.

## Changes

- Move Kotlin sources and tests to match the `salu.Kandoraq.Miauterm` package.
- Rename the native PTY library and JNI entry points to Miauterm.
- Coordinate PTY reaping so concurrent waiters share one child exit status instead of calling `waitpid` more than once.
- Guard Back handling while runtime initialization is waiting on the notification permission prompt.
- Keep the app API server scoped to an active app or terminal service lifecycle.
- Avoid retaining `MainActivity` through the service and prevent duplicate session-change callbacks.
- Improve Debian repair/startup coordination, alternate-screen recovery, and extra-key touch targets.
- Use Debian-provided utilities for PRoot diagnostic log rotation.

## Name reference

The `salu` in `salu.Kandoraq.Miauterm` refers to the phrase “Pitu Ba'bana Binanga Pitu Ulunna Salu,” meaning “seven kingdoms on the coast and seven kingdoms in the mountains.” In this phrase, “Salu” is part of the proper name of a federation of kingdoms in the Mandar highlands, not merely the generic word for “river.” This is the cultural reference behind Miauterm's package name, not a claim that the word or name is exclusive to Miauterm or its author.

## Package identity notice

The Android application ID is now `salu.Kandoraq.Miauterm`. Android treats it as a separate app from earlier Miauterm releases, so this release does not upgrade them in place or migrate their private app data. The earlier app can remain installed separately.
